scopePolicy: Use NGCB active nonrestricted gaming locations as the authoritative starting universe for Nevada casino-destination reconciliation. Restricted slot-only locations, route locations, online-only operators, and distributed retail gaming are outside Dinner Roulette's destination-casino scope. Nonrestricted locations still require property-by-property destination review because the regulatory class can include gaming operations that are not necessarily destination casinos.
authorityFindings: NGCB's Statistics & Publications page provides a Location Name and Address List by licensed type, a Restricted and Nonrestricted Locations Report, and a Nonrestricted Count Report.
NGCB describes the Restricted and Nonrestricted Locations Report as containing names and addresses of all restricted and nonrestricted locations.
NGCB Tax & License issues gaming licenses and monitors Indian gaming in Nevada.
Nevada requires a larger property-level reconciliation than prior jurisdictions; a raw nonrestricted license count must not be treated as a curated casino count.
